task_summary: Executed multi-module architecture and UI/UX overhaul across 3 core systems: 1) Defense Scheduling Calendar & Committee Readiness Gate: mini-calendar popover date selection with synchronized 5-day week highlighting across month boundaries, compact ergonomic modal container (<88vh) with pinned header/footer and quick timeslot chips, and institutional committee readiness enforcement (hasAdviser && panelistCount >= 3) displaying amber 'Committee Incomplete' badges with missing appointment counts preventing premature hearings. 2) Reports & Analytics Dashboard Overhaul (/reports): transformed static query builder into an automatically hydrated live dashboard on mount (hasGenerated=true, default AY), 5-metric demographic & yield KPI ribbon (CohortKPIRibbon.jsx), persistent quick filter ribbon with slide-out Advanced Query Studio drawer (ReportsFilterDrawer.jsx), modular Recharts visualization studio (DynamicChartWidget.jsx) with runtime switching between Bar, Line, Pie, Radar, and Tabular views, and enterprise DDE-sanitized CSV export (exportReportsToCSV.js). 3) Project Viewer 70/30 Grid & Faculty Committee Card: enforced 60-30-10 HSL design token rule, created FacultyCommitteeCard.jsx with committee completeness status, faculty workload capacity badges (Optimal <3, Near Capacity 3-5, Overloaded >5), and FRAD2 proponent team roster with standardized technical roles. Passed 38/38 unit tests across 5 test suites, 204/182 endpoint parity (UNMATCHED_COUNT=0), 60/60 agentic validation checks, pristine workspace guardrails, and full 12-screenshot Playwright visual audit across light and dark modes in desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844).
